text:
sanjay: Quick heads-up — we've got a reproducible ~22% drop in prefill cache hit-rate after the 03:00 runtime+model rollout. Heatmap linked. @eng-runtime

marie: Can you paste the numbers and a quick diff vs yesterday?

sanjay: baseline (yesterday 23:40): prefill_hit_rate=0.87
current (after 03:00): prefill_hit_rate=0.68
p50 latency +3ms, p95 +28ms
tokens_saved/day down from 1.2M -> 0.94M

leo: dump from runtime profile looks like new kernel's key salt changed during rehash. snippet:

```
KV_CACHE_KEY v1: sha1(prefix||model_id||seed)
KV_CACHE_KEY v2: sha1(prefix||model_id||seed||shard_id)
```

leo: if shard_id is different between compilation units we get misses.

nora: did the tokenizer change? we toggled normalize_unicode in model load recently.

sanjay: ran sample compare — first token sequences differ for ~6% of prompts (mostly emoji and non-ascii). command:

```
python tools/tokenize_diff.py --model r-infer-v2 --sample 1k
```

sanjay: output example:

```
old: [CLS] Hello, world! \n
new: [CLS] Hello, world!\n️
```

marie: ok two potential axes: key schema drift (leo) and token normalization (nora). which is dominant?

leo: quick A/B with legacy key scheme turned on showed hit-rate back to 0.86 within 15m. so key schema change is the main culprit.

perf-bot: ALERT cache_hit_rate_drop service=runtime env=prod delta=-0.19 severity=warning :bell:

nora: great catch. we need a long-term fix: either keep key deterministic across kernels or bake shard_id into a versioned namespace so keys don't collide.

marie: immediate task: 1) enable KV_CACHE_LEGACY_NAMESPACE=1 on canaries 2) roll forward patch to canonicalize key salt at compile time 3) add unit test for key canonicalization

sanjay: applying 1) now to canaries. patch link: https://stash.redwood/infra/kv-key-canon/PR-42

leo: also adding telemetry to log key components for a 5% sample so we can quantify other differences.

sanjay: canaries show hit-rate restored -> 0.85, p95 trending down. escalating to rollback candidate if anything diverges.

marie: assign owners: leo for key patch, nora for tokenizer normalization check, sanjay for canary rollout and logs. follow-up meeting in #eng-runtime tomorrow 10:30.

sanjay: thanks all :thumbsup:
